]), size=(40, 40), at=(200, 100), layer="things")

running = True

    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching planet scores a point.
